title: kali rosaceum
intro: Kali rosaceum, commonly known as Sea Rose or Indian Pink Salt Flower, is a type of flowering plant. It is a succulent that belongs to the Kalanchoe genus, native to Madagascar. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Kali rosaceum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which provide its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
